component.name: Deinstall
component.summary: List installed applications and uninstall them, whatever their source

description.p: Deinstall is a GTK4 and libadwaita desktop application that lists every application installed on your system — regardless of whether it came from apt, snap, Flatpak, or an AppImage — and lets you uninstall it cleanly from one place.
It automatically detects each application's installation source, so you no longer have to guess which package manager owns it before removing it.
